ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_BranchGroupDescription_DEP] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription AS 
(
SELECT
	 BDS.SET_ID AS BranchGroupId
	,BDS.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,BDS.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
	,BDS.SET_DESC AS BranchGroupDescription
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BDS.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.DEP_SETIDTABLE BDS
 WHERE BDS.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription FROM TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,BranchGroupId)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,BranchGroupDescription)
)) HASHROW, BranchGroupId, Timestamp, FinancialInstitutionId
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,A.BranchGroupId)
,convert(varchar,A.FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,A.BranchGroupDescription)
)) HASHROW, A.BranchGroupId, A.Timestamp, A.FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BNKM.BranchGroupDescription  A
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchGroupId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.BranchGroupDescription GROUP BY BranchGroupId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
		ON A.BranchGroupId = B.BranchGroupId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.BranchGroupId,TGT.BranchGroupId) AS BranchGroupId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'  
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'INSERT'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.BranchGroupId = TGT.BranchGroupId
AND	SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL 
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_DELTA;


 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.BranchGroupDescription
(
	BranchGroupId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,Timestamp
	,BranchGroupDescription
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
DISTINCT
	SRC.BranchGroupId
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SRC.Timestamp
	,SRC.BranchGroupDescription
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.BranchGroupId = SRC.BranchGroupId  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_DELTA;

END
GO
